caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two doors, set against a plain, off-white background. The cabinet is rectangular with a slightly curved top edge. Each door consists of a central rectangular panel bordered by a frame, with the panels displaying visible wood grain and knots in shades of light brown and grey. The top and bottom borders of each panel have a zigzag pattern carved into the wood. There are three dark metal hinges attached vertically on each side of the cabinet, for a total of six. The hinges are visibly bolted to the frame and doors. At the lower center where the two doors meet, a simple wooden latch is present. The cabinet has a rustic appearance, with the wood’s natural texture and grain lines distinctly illustrated. Below the right side of the cabinet, text is written that reads: “MAJEL C. CHAPLIN · TAOS · N. M.”
title: Two Wall Doors
